stories.headline: Nvidia invests $4B in Lumentum and Coherent to secure silicon photonics for AI data centers
key_facts: Nvidia announced $2 billion investments in each of Lumentum and Coherent, totaling $4 billion, to advance co-packaged optics for AI infrastructure
Deals include multibillion-dollar purchase commitments and future capacity access rights for advanced laser components
Initial 1.6-terabit co-packaged optics shipments begin in 2026; Lumentum expects several hundred million dollars in CPO laser orders for first-half 2027 delivery
Coherent's order-to-ship ratio exceeds four times current throughput, with bookings extending through 2027-2028
Lumentum reports sold-out wafer fab capacity and will use funds to build new US-based manufacturing fabs
Coherent plans to double indium phosphide capacity by year-end to meet demand

stories.headline: Ayar Labs raises $500M Series E at $3.75B valuation to scale co-packaged optics production
key_facts: Ayar Labs closed $500 million in Series E funding led by Neuberger Berman, bringing total funding to $870 million at a $3.75 billion valuation
New investors include ARK Invest, Insight Partners, Qatar Investment Authority, Sequoia Global Equities, and 1789 Capital
Strategic investors AMD, Alchip, MediaTek, and Nvidia participated in the round
Funds will scale high-volume production and test capacity for the company's co-packaged optics solution
CEO Mark Wade said copper interconnects are becoming the bottleneck, consuming too much power and limiting AI throughput per watt
Ayar competes with Celestial AI (which raised $250M in March 2025) and Nvidia-backed Lumentum and Coherent

stories.headline: Micron ships industry-first 256GB LPDRAM SOCAMM2 module for AI data center servers
key_facts: Micron began shipping customer samples of the industry's highest-capacity LPDRAM module — 256GB SOCAMM2 — based on its first monolithic 32Gb LPDDR5X die
Enables 2TB of LPDRAM per 8-channel server CPU for AI and high-performance computing workloads
Delivers 2.3x faster time to first token for long-context LLM inference compared to currently available solutions
Provides 3x better performance per watt in standalone CPU applications versus mainstream memory modules
Consumes one-third the power and one-third the footprint of equivalent RDIMMs, improving rack density and total cost of ownership
Micron is collaborating with Nvidia to co-design memory for advanced AI infrastructure

stories.headline: Google, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon and others sign White House pledge to self-power AI data centers
key_facts: Google, Microsoft, Meta, Oracle, xAI, OpenAI, and Amazon will sign the Ratepayer Protection Pledge at the White House on March 4-5
Companies commit to build, bring, or buy their own power supply for new AI data centers so Americans' electricity bills will not increase
Pledge ensures infrastructure and power delivery expenses are not passed on to the public
Companies also commit to hiring and training workers from communities where data centers operate
AWS CEO Matt Garman said the pledge establishes a clear baseline to protect ratepayers while enabling responsible long-term energy partnerships
Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the pledge aims to stop rising electricity prices while ensuring the US wins the AI race

stories.headline: Xiaomi deploys humanoid robots in EV factory, achieving 90% task completion at production-line speed
key_facts: Xiaomi trialed humanoid robots in its electric vehicle factory, with two robots completing 90% of tasks in three hours at the self-tapping nut assembly station
Robots matched the factory's 76-second production cycle time for new vehicles coming off the assembly line
Achieved 90.2% success rate for simultaneous dual-side installation at the nut assembly workstation
President Lu Weibing told CNBC at MWC that humanoid robots will eventually replace humans for certain work and accomplish tasks humans could not
Robots leverage Xiaomi's vision-language-action foundation model called Xiaomi-Robotics-0 combining multimodal perception and reinforcement learning
Xiaomi targets large-scale humanoid deployment within five years; CEO Lei Jun said key performance indicators are steadily improving

stories.headline: BMW deploys humanoid robots in German car production for the first time, launches Physical AI center
key_facts: BMW launched a pilot project with Hexagon Robotics' AEON humanoid robot at its Leipzig plant — first humanoid robot deployment in European automotive production
New Center of Competence for Physical AI in Production established to consolidate expertise and accelerate global integration
AEON robot will be used in high-voltage battery assembly and component manufacturing for exterior parts starting summer 2026
Prior pilot at Spartanburg, USA with Figure AI's Figure 02 robot completed approximately 1,250 operating hours, moved over 90,000 components across 1.2 million steps
Spartanburg pilot supported production of over 30,000 BMW X3 vehicles with robots working 10-hour daily shifts Monday through Friday
Initial AEON test deployment at Leipzig began in December 2025; formal pilot phase starts summer 2026

stories.headline: NASA fixes Artemis II SLS helium blockage, preserves April 2026 lunar flyby launch window
key_facts: Engineers identified a dislodged seal in a quick-disconnect fitting that blocked helium flow to the ICPS upper stage during the February 20-21 wet dress rehearsal
Technicians removed the quick-disconnect, repositioned the seal, and confirmed helium was flowing after the repair
The SLS rocket was rolled back to the Vehicle Assembly Building on February 25 for repairs after the issue could not be fixed at the launch pad
While repairing the helium system, workers also replaced batteries in the core stage, ICPS, boosters, and flight termination system
A seal in the core stage liquid oxygen feed system was also replaced, with work beginning March 2
Repairs keep a potential April 2026 launch of Artemis II on track, with the earliest possible date of April 1

stories.headline: Japan's Space One aborts Kairos No. 3 rocket launch 30 seconds before liftoff due to signal issue
key_facts: Space One aborted the Kairos No. 3 launch 30 seconds before planned liftoff from Spaceport Kii in Wakayama Prefecture on March 4
Safety monitoring system activated due to unstable signal reception from a positioning satellite
The 18-meter, 23-ton solid-fuel rocket was loaded with five satellites intended for orbit at approximately 500 km altitude
Launch has been rescheduled for Thursday with a window between 11:10 and 11:20 a.m. local time
This was the second cancellation in a week after a previous weather-related postponement
Space One's track record includes a Kairos No. 1 explosion shortly after liftoff in March 2024 and Kairos No. 2 abort three minutes after launch in December 2024
